"# MASTER PROMPT: TOYS VS. NIGHTMARES

## 1. Core Identity @COMMENT_BODY@ Elevator Pitch
Buatlah sebuah game lane-defense 2D berperspektif top-down (portrait) dengan gaya visual kartun 2D bergaya mainan (tebal, cerah, tekstur kertas). Game ini ditujukan untuk mobile Android/iOS. Fantasi pemain adalah menjadi \"Guardian\" tak terlihat yang mengatur pasukan mainan hidup untuk melindungi tidur seorang anak dari monster mimpi buruk. Gameplay berfokus pada penempatan unit taktis di 5 jalur, manajemen resource cepat, dan kombinasi unit (synergy) yang memuaskan.

## 2. Core Loop Mechanic
Implementasikan loop gameplay utama berikut untuk sesi bermain 5-10 menit:
1. LEVEL START: Pemain memilih level, layar menampilkan kamar tidur malam hari.
2. RESOURCE GATHERING: Pemain mengetuk \"Bintang\" (Starlight) yang jatuh dari langit atau dihasilkan oleh unit khusus untuk menambah mata uang in-level.
3. UNIT PLACEMENT: Pemain memilih unit dari bar bawah dan menempatkannya di grid 5x9 (sel kosong) dengan membayar biaya Bintang.
4. AUTO-COMBAT: Unit secara otomatis menyerang monster (Nightmares) yang berjalan dari kanan ke kiri di jalur yang sama.
5. DEFENSE: Jika monster mencapai ujung kiri (kolom 0), \"Dream Meter\" (HP rumah) berkurang.
6. WAVE PROGRESSION: Setelah semua monster di wave saat ini mati, wave berikutnya spawn dengan kesulitan meningkat.
7. VICTORY/DEFEAT: Jika Dream Meter > 0 setelah semua wave selesai, menang dan dapat reward. Jika 0, kalah dan retry.
8. META PROGRESSION: Reward (Bulan) digunakan di menu utama untuk mengupgrade statistik unit secara permanen.

## 3. Progression @COMMENT_BODY@ Economy
- **Currencies:** 
  - Starlight (In-level): Reset tiap level. Sumber: jatuh acak @COMMENT_BODY@ unit generator. Sink: beli unit.
  - Moon (Meta Soft): Persisten. Sumber: selesai level @COMMENT_BODY@ daily quest. Sink: upgrade unit.
  - Gem (Meta Hard): Persisten. Sumber: IAP @COMMENT_BODY@ achievement. Sink: kosmetik @COMMENT_BODY@ skip.
- **Progression:** Guardian Level (GL) naik berdasarkan total XP. GL 1 unlock Teddy Knight, GL 2 unlock Robot Soldier, dst hingga GL 8.
- **Balancing:** 
  - Grid: 5 baris x 9 kolom. 
  - Teddy Knight: Cost 25, HP 60, Dmg 10, Atk Speed 1.0s, Range 1 (melee).
  - Zombie Mouse: HP 30, Dmg 5, Move Speed 1 sel/2s, Dream Dmg 10.
  - Dream Meter: 100 poin. Menang jika >0, kalah jika 0.

## 4. Visual @COMMENT_BODY@ Audio Direction
- **Art Style:** 2D kartun dengan outline tebal. Palet: Background malam (#1a1a2e), UI Gold (#ffd700) @COMMENT_BODY@ Cyan (#00d4ff).
- **Animation:** Smooth tweening. Hit-stop 80ms saat proyektil kena musuh. Screen shake 3px saat musuh mati.
- **Camera:** Fixed top-down, tidak bergerak.
- **Audio:** Musik piano/strings cozy. SFX \"boing\" dan \"pop\" yang juicy.

## 5. UI/UX Overview
- **Game HUD:** 
  - Top-Left: Dream Meter bar (Hijau/Kuning/Merah).
  - Top-Center: Wave counter (e.g., \"Wave 2/7\").
  - Bottom-Left: Starlight counter.
  - Bottom-Center: Scrollable unit selection bar (menampilkan cost @COMMENT_BODY@ cooldown).
  - Bottom-Right: Star Power button (lingkaran, fill 0-100%).
- **UX Principle:** Tap-to-place. Validasi visual instan (merah jika tidak bisa taruh, hijau jika bisa).
"

export function guardianLevelForXp(xp) {
  let level = 1;
  for (let index = 0; index < GUARDIAN_XP.length; index += 1) {
    if (xp >= GUARDIAN_XP[index]) level = index + 1;
  }
  return Math.min(level, 8);
}

export function xpForNextLevel(level) {
  if (level >= 8) return null;
  return GUARDIAN_XP[level];
}

export function isUnitUnlocked(unit, guardianLevel) {
  return guardianLevel >= unit.unlock;
}

export function unitStats(unit, upgradeLevel = 0) {
  const scale = 1 + upgradeLevel * 0.1;
  return {
    ...unit,
    hp: Math.round(unit.hp * scale),
    damage: unit.damage ? Math.round(unit.damage * scale) : 0,
    heal: unit.heal ? Math.round(unit.heal * scale) : 0,
    generate: unit.generate ? Math.round(unit.generate * scale) : 0,
  };
}

export function upgradeCost(upgradeLevel) {
  return 40 + upgradeLevel * 35;
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished, playable mobile-first 2D lane-defense game “Toys vs. Nightmares” in the empty PlayGround repo, matching the supplied master prompt.

## Requirements
- Portrait top-down lane-defense for Android/iOS, 5 lanes × 9 columns.
- Core loop: select level, collect falling Starlight, place units, auto-combat, defend Dream Meter, 7 escalating waves, victory/defeat, Moon meta-upgrades.
- Currencies: Starlight (in-run), Moon (persistent soft), Gems (hard/achievements).
- Guardian Levels GL1–GL8 unlock 8 units; Teddy Knight cost 25, HP 60, DMG 10, 1.0s attack, range 1; Zombie Mouse HP 30, DMG 5, 0.5 cells/s, 10 Dream damage; Dream Meter 100.
- Visual direction: thick-outline cartoon toys, night palette `#1a1a2e`, gold `#ffd700`, cyan `#00d4ff`, paper texture, tweening, 80ms hit-stop on projectile hit, 3px screen shake on enemy death.
- Audio: cozy piano/strings, juicy “boing”/“pop” SFX.
- HUD: Dream Meter top-left, wave top-center, Starlight bottom-left, scrollable unit bar bottom-center, Star Power button bottom-right.
- UX: tap-to-place with instant green/red validation.

## Decisions
- Built dependency-free static HTML/CSS/ES-module canvas game served by existing `start.sh` runtime.
- Virtual resolution 480×854 scaled into a centered portrait frame.
- All art procedurally drawn in Canvas 2D; bundled local fonts (`Baloo 2`, `Lilita One`) to avoid network dependence.
- Added 8 units, 5 enemy types, 3 levels, daily quests, achievements, workshop upgrades, help screen, pause/result overlays.
- Game time step capped at 0.25s to compensate for very low browser rAF rate in the test environment.
- Exposed `window.__toys` in `src/main.js` for debugging/testing.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game codebase implemented: data, procedural art, game logic, rendering, HUD, input, audio, app screens, save/economy.
- Menu screen visually verified via screenshot.
- Gameplay screen verified with Teddy placement, enemies, falling stars, cooldown overlay, wave progress, Dream Meter.
- Workshop, quests, help, result/pause overlays implemented but not yet visually verified.
- Server running in tmux session `game` at `http://localhost:3000`.

### Active
- Visual QA and bug-fixing of gameplay/UI.
- Full win/loss flow and persistence testing.
- Mobile layout/responsiveness polish.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the latest gameplay screenshot; fix visible UI issues (notably “STAR POWER” label appears clipped at right).
2. Verify Workshop, Quests, Help, Pause, Victory, Defeat screens via Playwright clicks/screenshots.
3. Test Star collection via actual pointer input reliably; increase star hit radius/lifetime if needed.
4. Test full wave progression/win/loss, Moon/XP rewards, GL unlock, daily quest claims, upgrades, and localStorage persistence.
5. Check browser console for runtime errors after all flows.
6. Improve gameplay visual richness/contrast if needed; finalize and commit changes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: canvas host, font/favicon links, boot screen.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: portrait frame, background, fonts, responsive layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: bootstrap, rAF loop, pointer/wheel input, `window.__toys`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js`: app state, save/economy, screen routing, level completion, quests/upgrades.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js`: units, enemies, levels/waves, quests, XP thresholds, stats.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.js`: gameplay simulation, waves, combat, placement, Star Power, results.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js`: gameplay pointer/drag/card/star/pause/result handling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/render.js`: gameplay world rendering.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/hud.js`: gameplay HUD, cards, toasts, tutorial, wave banner.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/overlays.js`: pause and result overlays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/draw.js`: procedural art, characters, backgrounds, UI primitives.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: WebAudio BGM and SFX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/screens-menu.js`: menu screen and menu input.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/screens-progress.js`: workshop, quests, help screens and input.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/screens.js`: re-export module for screens.

## Important Context
- Working tree changes are uncommitted; repo initially contained only scaffolding.
- Browser/Playwright works after `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`; use `playwright-cli -s=game ...`.
- Canvas CSS rect is approximately `{x:0,y:27.44,w:430,h:765.11}` at 430×820 viewport; virtual coords map by `x/430*480`, `(y-27.44)/765.11*854`.
- rAF in this environment is only ~3.5 fps; rendering itself measured ~1.4ms/frame, so low FPS is browser throttling, not canvas cost.
- `gamePointerDown` sets `game.pointer`; star collection logic itself works via `game.collectStar(star)`, but an attempted Playwright click missed a moving/expired star.
- Latest debug state after cheating 10 Teddy Knights: units rendered correctly, wave advanced to 2/7, Dream Meter at 60, enemy damage floaters working.
- Known visual issues: Star Power label may clip at right; grid could use stronger visual differentiation; tutorial hint overlaps lower playfield edge but is readable.

"# MASTER PROMPT: TOYS VS. NIGHTMARES

## 1. Core Identity @COMMENT_BODY@ Elevator Pitch
Buatlah sebuah game lane-defense 2D berperspektif top-down (portrait) dengan gaya visual kartun 2D bergaya mainan (tebal, cerah, tekstur kertas). Game ini ditujukan untuk mobile Android/iOS. Fantasi pemain adalah menjadi \"Guardian\" tak terlihat yang mengatur pasukan mainan hidup untuk melindungi tidur seorang anak dari monster mimpi buruk. Gameplay berfokus pada penempatan unit taktis di 5 jalur, manajemen resource cepat, dan kombinasi unit (synergy) yang memuaskan.

## 2. Core Loop Mechanic
Implementasikan loop gameplay utama berikut untuk sesi bermain 5-10 menit:
1. LEVEL START: Pemain memilih level, layar menampilkan kamar tidur malam hari.
2. RESOURCE GATHERING: Pemain mengetuk \"Bintang\" (Starlight) yang jatuh dari langit atau dihasilkan oleh unit khusus untuk menambah mata uang in-level.
3. UNIT PLACEMENT: Pemain memilih unit dari bar bawah dan menempatkannya di grid 5x9 (sel kosong) dengan membayar biaya Bintang.
4. AUTO-COMBAT: Unit secara otomatis menyerang monster (Nightmares) yang berjalan dari kanan ke kiri di jalur yang sama.
5. DEFENSE: Jika monster mencapai ujung kiri (kolom 0), \"Dream Meter\" (HP rumah) berkurang.
6. WAVE PROGRESSION: Setelah semua monster di wave saat ini mati, wave berikutnya spawn dengan kesulitan meningkat.
7. VICTORY/DEFEAT: Jika Dream Meter > 0 setelah semua wave selesai, menang dan dapat reward. Jika 0, kalah dan retry.
8. META PROGRESSION: Reward (Bulan) digunakan di menu utama untuk mengupgrade statistik unit secara permanen.

## 3. Progression @COMMENT_BODY@ Economy
- **Currencies:** 
  - Starlight (In-level): Reset tiap level. Sumber: jatuh acak @COMMENT_BODY@ unit generator. Sink: beli unit.
  - Moon (Meta Soft): Persisten. Sumber: selesai level @COMMENT_BODY@ daily quest. Sink: upgrade unit.
  - Gem (Meta Hard): Persisten. Sumber: IAP @COMMENT_BODY@ achievement. Sink: kosmetik @COMMENT_BODY@ skip.
- **Progression:** Guardian Level (GL) naik berdasarkan total XP. GL 1 unlock Teddy Knight, GL 2 unlock Robot Soldier, dst hingga GL 8.
- **Balancing:** 
  - Grid: 5 baris x 9 kolom. 
  - Teddy Knight: Cost 25, HP 60, Dmg 10, Atk Speed 1.0s, Range 1 (melee).
  - Zombie Mouse: HP 30, Dmg 5, Move Speed 1 sel/2s, Dream Dmg 10.
  - Dream Meter: 100 poin. Menang jika >0, kalah jika 0.

## 4. Visual @COMMENT_BODY@ Audio Direction
- **Art Style:** 2D kartun dengan outline tebal. Palet: Background malam (#1a1a2e), UI Gold (#ffd700) @COMMENT_BODY@ Cyan (#00d4ff).
- **Animation:** Smooth tweening. Hit-stop 80ms saat proyektil kena musuh. Screen shake 3px saat musuh mati.
- **Camera:** Fixed top-down, tidak bergerak.
- **Audio:** Musik piano/strings cozy. SFX \"boing\" dan \"pop\" yang juicy.

## 5. UI/UX Overview
- **Game HUD:** 
  - Top-Left: Dream Meter bar (Hijau/Kuning/Merah).
  - Top-Center: Wave counter (e.g., \"Wave 2/7\").
  - Bottom-Left: Starlight counter.
  - Bottom-Center: Scrollable unit selection bar (menampilkan cost @COMMENT_BODY@ cooldown).
  - Bottom-Right: Star Power button (lingkaran, fill 0-100%).
- **UX Principle:** Tap-to-place. Validasi visual instan (merah jika tidak bisa taruh, hijau jika bisa).
"
